technical_decision_rationale: Under the project's strict fail-closed governance criteria, all technical benchmarks and gates must pass completely. Because the host Windows NTFS physical drive enforces journal metadata commit latencies that bound file-append P95 latency to ~13.96 ms vs the 5.0 ms micro-benchmark requirement, and CBE rules strictly prohibit weakening os.fsync durability or manufacturing results, this benchmark is legitimately classified as BLOCKED and the technical gate must remain TECHNICAL_NO_GO until tested on a designated low-latency storage tier or staging container.
